_comment: Spike decoding — rate decoding (decode_rate) on 10K neurons × 10 time bins, workgroup=256, dispatch=40. SHIMMED UNIFORM: DecodeParams = { neuron_count: u32, time_window: u32, decoding_mode: u32, population_size: u32, output_min: f32, output_max: f32, _pad0: u32, _pad1: u32 } = 32 bytes. Hand-packed via uniform-u32-tuple with f32 fields as IEEE-754 u32 bit patterns: output_min=0.0 → 0; output_max=1.0 → 0x3f800000=1065353216. Pipeline layout:'auto' on decode_rate binds only the 3 declarations the function uses (params, spike_train, output_data); tuning_curves @ (0,3) is declared in the module but not consumed by decode_rate, so it is omitted to avoid an extra BGL entry mismatch.
section: Spike decoding — rate decoding mode, inverse companion to spike-encode (paper-2-encode-rate-1k.json). Converts a binary spike train [neuron × time] back into a normalized continuous value [neuron] by summing spikes per neuron and rescaling to [output_min, output_max].
